title: Automated contract deviation runbook for structured outputs
creator: Ava Thompson
description: Problem: We keep seeing subtle field-level contract deviations (missing keys, nulls in non-nullable fields, unexpected arrays, and small format changes) surface only after canary rollouts or in production pockets. Current schema validators flag only gross mismatches and provide poor signal-to-noise for low-latency rollouts. Goal: Build an automated runbook that detects contract deviations tied to specific model/config changes, scores severity per-field, surfaces root cause (config delta, model variant, tokenization change), and integrates with rollout gating and alerting channels.
acceptance_criteria: Per-deployment artifact: all requests are checked against a typed contract and a deviation score is emitted and stored for each sample
Daily and rollout-window alerts for fieldwise deviation score breaches (config-aware thresholds) with linkable golden samples
Canary job that blocks rollouts when deviation breach persists above threshold for configurable window (default 5 minutes / 1% of traffic)
Auto-populated investigation card with top 5 affected fields, sample examples, config/model diffs, and suggested rollback PR template
Dashboards showing baseline field distributions, recent deltas by config, and SLO for structured-output integrity
tasks: Design field-level scoring model (type, cardinality, format, value-set entropy) - M2
Implement lightweight runtime validator in serving runtime that emits deviation events with metadata (model, config hash, route)
Expand eval harness to run synthetic mutations against golden set and compute per-field sensitivity baselines
Create canary gating integration that subscribes to deviation stream and exposes blocking verdicts to rollout controller
Build a Slack/PagerDuty alert template and automated investigation card generator in the console
Instrument dashboards and retention policy for deviation telemetry (30d hot / 365d cold)
Write e2e tests and a PR template for emergency rollback with required artifacts attached
updates: 2025-02-16: Kickoff meeting with runtime, evals, and console leads. Agreed on baseline scoring signals: type mismatch, missing-key-rate, unexpected-array-rate, format-violation-rate, and out-of-range numeric tails.
2025-02-18: Prototype field scoring lib (Python) completed. Early experiments on golden dataset show missing-key-rate is the highest-signal metric for our use-cases.

2025-02-21: Integrated prototype validator into shadow-serving path for two internal models. Collected 12k deviation events; observed two false positives where training data change introduced expected new enum values.
2025-02-24: Started building mutation harness to produce edge-case samples (empty arrays, truncated strings, unicode variants). Helps set per-field thresholds automatically.
2025-02-27: Console team agreed to accept investigation payloads via new /investigation endpoint. Draft of Slack alert message attached to this ticket (see links).
2025-03-01: Security review flagged that deviation events must not include PII; runtime team will apply scrub rules. Adjusted acceptance criteria to require PII-safe sampling.
notes: Design note: thresholds should be config-aware. Example: quantized-llama-7b with small context will expect shorter string lengths — baselines must be computed per (model_variant, quant, seq_len_profile)
Operational note: sample retention must omit full user text for alerts; include tokenized diffs and canonicalized examples only
Tradeoff: aggressive blocking reduces incidents but increases blocked deploys during benign schema expansions; we will allow opt-in for permissive schema-expansion windows
